cli.description: Local AI voice generator (queue, takes, chosen voice and lines).
cli.help.lang: language of the messages (default: the system's)
cli.cmd.project_add: register the project in a folder
cli.cmd.order_submit: create or update an order and queue its takes (shows the warnings of the design sheet)
cli.cmd.order_list: list the orders of a project (lines made with an old reference are marked as stale)
cli.cmd.order_show: show an order with its takes
cli.cmd.attempt_new: queue new takes (random seed unless --seed is given)
cli.cmd.attempt_mark: mark a take as new, candidate or discarded
cli.cmd.attempt_note: set the note of a take
cli.cmd.choose: choose a take (for a voice: it becomes the reference and its voice prints are queued)
cli.cmd.work: process the queue until it is empty
cli.arg.file: order JSON file, or - for standard input
cli.arg.chosen: only orders with a chosen take
cli.arg.unchosen: only orders without a chosen take
error.install.unknown_device: unknown device "{device}": it must be CPU or start with Vulkan
error.install.unknown_binary: unknown engine program "{binary}"; use one of: {binaries}
error.install.unreadable: cannot read the engine install record {path}: {reason}
